Repair PR #10 PushKit without rewriting the working registry implementation. The pinned evidence does not establish the NSString bytes for PKPushType.voIP, complication, or fileProvider. Stop asserting ‘PKPushTypeVoIP’, ‘PKPushTypeComplication’, and ‘PKPushTypeFileProvider’ as Apple-observed values. A source-compatible Linux fallback may remain only if README/coverage calls it Linux-local and the affected constants/raw-value semantics are ‘declared’, not ‘implemented’. Tests may verify typed equality, distinctness, hashing, fail-closed registration, weak delegate behavior, existential delegate dispatch, and host-injected callbacks, but must not present guessed literal bytes as Apple parity.

Add tests/agent/PushKitDependencyIdentity.swift for the future EC2 build against the real guest Foundation module. It must prove PKPushCredentials.token and PKPushPayload values use Foundation.Data, exercise an override through any PKPushRegistryDelegate, link libPushKit.dylib, and emit a unique success marker. EC2 dependency set: Foundation plus the platform Dispatch/runtime.

Repair PR #16 CoreMotion while preserving the broad value/model implementation. Its oracle ledger admits that CMError raw values, default update intervals, unavailable-hardware active-state transitions, heading sentinel, quaternion/Euler convention, and synchronous water-submersion delegate behavior are unobserved, yet all 435 rows are marked implemented and tests enforce those guesses.

Stop asserting unobserved numeric ABI or defaults as Apple parity. Keep necessary source-compatible Linux fallback values only with declared coverage and explicit notes. With every availability property false, start* calls must not fabricate an active sensor session; remain inactive and deliver the fail-closed error on the supplied OperationQueue where an error channel exists. Assigning CMWaterSubmersionManager.delegate must not synchronously invent a hardware error callback. Treat quaternion convention as declared until an Apple oracle exists, while retaining tests for internal mathematical consistency. Remove vacuous assertions such as ‘hashValue != 0 || true’ and make every implemented row’s evidence meaningful.
